Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified James Kirkwood Sr.’s death date as April 21, 1989, instead of the correct date of August 24, 1963. This error occurred when the Planner failed to differentiate between James Kirkwood Sr. (the film director) and James Kirkwood Jr. (the writer). This misstep led to confusion in subsequent steps and compromised the process of comparing the directors' death dates accurately.
